n: 30-Inch Single Wall Oven with Air Fry When Connected - 5.0 Cu. Ft.
desc: Tackle your to-do list with a Smart Wall Oven built for multitasking. Get crispy results in this single wall oven with air fryer (available via Automatic Feature Updates* when appliance is connected), while Fan Convection Cooking and Frozen Bake™ Technology let you do more in and out of the kitchen.
hl: Get instant access to the settings you use most with a full-color Touchscreen display.
A concealed bake element placed under the floor of the oven creates a smooth surface at the bottom of the oven for easy cleaning.
Keep hot food hot without having to keep cooking.
When you’re busy elsewhere, use your smartphone to get dinner started by remotely preheating the oven.
Cook however you want with 6 cooking modes in one wall oven: Frozen Bake™ Technology, Keep Warm, Broil, Convect Broil, Bake and Convect Bake.
Easily cook large meals with 5.0 Cu. Ft. Oven Capacity.
